title: The Minimum Cardinality of a Dependent Finite Gabor System Is Four
summary: Recent work produced a linearly dependent system of twelve time--frequency shifts of a Schwartz function, disproving the HRT conjecture. We show that four shifts already suffice, and hence that four is the smallest possible cardinality of a dependent finite Gabor system. More precisely, set $α=\frac13+10^{-12}\sqrt2$ and $β=\frac13+10^{-12}\sqrt3$. We construct a nonzero complex-valued function $f\in\mathcal S(\mathbb R)$ and $λ\ne0$ such that $\left(I+\frac12W(1,0)+\frac12W(0,1/2)\right)W(α,β/2)f=λf$, where $W$ denotes the Weyl time--frequency shift.
